verses.1:1: The revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to Him to show His servants the things that must happen soon; and He signified it by sending it through His angel to His servant John,
verses.1:2: who testified to the word of God and the testimony of Jesus Christ—everything he saw.
verses.1:3: Blessed is the one who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy and keep the things written in it, because the time is near.
verses.1:4: John, to the seven churches that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from the One who is and who was and who is coming, and from the seven spirits that are before His throne,
verses.1:5: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To the One who loves us and freed us from our sins by His blood—
verses.1:6: and He made us a kingdom, priests to His God and Father—to Him be the glory and the might forever and ever. Amen.
verses.1:7: Look, He is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see Him, including those who pierced Him, and all the tribes of the earth will wail over Him. Yes, amen.
verses.1:8: "I am the Alpha and the Omega," says the Lord God, the One who is and who was and who is coming, the Almighty.
verses.1:9: I, John, your brother and fellow sharer in the affliction and kingdom and endurance in Jesus, was on the island called Patmos on account of the word of God and the testimony of Jesus.
verses.1:10: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard a loud voice behind me, like a trumpet,
verses.1:11: saying, "Write in a scroll what you see and send it to the seven churches: to Ephesus, and to Smyrna, and to Pergamum, and to Thyatira, and to Sardis, and to Philadelphia, and to Laodicea."
verses.1:12: And I turned to see the voice that was speaking with me, and when I turned I saw seven golden lampstands,
verses.1:13: and in the middle of the lampstands, one like a son of man, dressed in a robe reaching to the feet and belted around His chest with a golden sash.
verses.1:14: His head and hair were white as white wool, as snow, and His eyes were like a flame of fire,
verses.1:15: and His feet were like fine bronze, as fired in a furnace, and His voice was like the sound of many waters,
verses.1:16: and in His right hand He was holding seven stars, and from His mouth a sharp double-edged sword was coming out, and His face was like the sun shining in its power.
verses.1:17: And when I saw Him, I fell at His feet like a dead man; and He laid His right hand on me, saying, "Do not be afraid. I am the first and the last,
verses.1:18: and the living One—and I died, and look, I am alive forever and ever—and I have the keys of death and of Hades.
verses.1:19: Write therefore the things you saw, and the things that are, and the things that are about to happen after these things.
verses.1:20: Regarding the mystery of the seven stars that you saw on My right hand, and the seven golden lampstands: the seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the seven lampstands are the seven churches."
verses.2:1: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write: "This is what the One who holds the seven stars in His right hand, the One who walks in the midst of the seven golden lampstands, says:
verses.2:2: I know your works, and your toil and endurance, and that you cannot bear evil people, and you tested those who call themselves apostles and are not, and found them to be false;
verses.2:3: and you have endurance, and you have borne up because of My name and have not grown weary.
verses.2:4: Yet I have this against you: you have left your first love.
verses.2:5: Remember, therefore, from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works. Otherwise, I am coming to you and will remove your lampstand from its place, unless you repent.
verses.2:6: Yet you have this: you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.
verses.2:7: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will grant him to eat from the tree of life, which is in the paradise of God."
verses.2:8: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: "This is what the First and the Last, who became dead and came to life, says:
verses.2:9: I know your affliction and your poverty (yet you are rich), and the slander from those who say they are Jews and are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.
verses.2:10: Do not fear at all the things you are about to suffer. Look, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison so that you may be tested, and you will have affliction for ten days. Prove yourself faithful until death, and I will give you the crown of life.
verses.2:11: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will by no means be harmed by the second death."
verses.2:12: And to the angel of the church in Pergamum write: "This is what the One who has the sharp two-edged sword says:
verses.2:13: I know where you dwell, where the throne of Satan is; and you hold fast to My name, and you did not deny My faith even in the days of Antipas, My witness, My faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.
verses.2:14: But I have a few things against you: you have there some who hold fast to the teaching of Balaam, who kept teaching Balak to place a stumbling block before the sons of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit sexual immorality.
verses.2:15: So you also have some who likewise hold fast to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
verses.2:16: Repent, therefore. Otherwise, I am coming to you quickly, and I will wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
verses.2:17: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give him some of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no one knows except the one who receives it."
verses.2:18: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: "This is what the Son of God says, the One who has His eyes like a flame of fire, and His feet are like burnished bronze:
verses.2:19: I know your works, and your love and faith and service and endurance, and that your last works are greater than the first.
verses.2:20: But I have this against you: you tolerate the woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, and she teaches and misleads My servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
verses.2:21: And I gave her time to repent, and she is unwilling to repent of her sexual immorality.
verses.2:22: Look, I am throwing her onto a bed, and those who commit adultery with her into great affliction, unless they repent of her works.
verses.2:23: And I will kill her children with death, and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts, and I will give to each one of you according to your works.
verses.2:24: But I say to you, the rest in Thyatira, as many as do not have this teaching, who have not known the deep things of Satan, as they say: I place no other burden on you;
verses.2:25: only hold fast to what you have until I come.
verses.2:26: And the one who overcomes and who keeps My works until the end, to him I will give authority over the nations,
verses.2:27: and he will shepherd them with an iron rod, as clay vessels are shattered,
verses.2:28: just as I also have received from My Father; and I will give him the morning star.
verses.2:29: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
verses.3:1: And to the angel of the church in Sardis write: "These things says the One who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I know your works, that you have a name that you are alive, and you are dead.
verses.3:2: Become watchful, and strengthen the remaining things that were about to die, for I have not found your works completed before My God.
verses.3:3: Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and keep it, and repent. If then you do not stay watchful, I will come like a thief, and you will by no means know at what hour I will come upon you.
verses.3:4: Yet you have a few names in Sardis who did not soil their garments, and they will walk with Me in white, because they are worthy.
verses.3:5: The one who conquers will thus be clothed in white garments, and I will by no means erase his name from the book of life, and I will acknowledge his name before My Father and before His angels.
verses.3:6: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
verses.3:7: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write: "These things says the Holy One, the True One, the One who has the key of David, the One who opens and no one will shut, and who shuts and no one opens:
verses.3:8: I know your works—look, I have placed before you an open door, which no one is able to shut—that you have little power, and kept My word, and did not deny My name.
verses.3:9: Look, I am giving some from the synagogue of Satan, those who say they are Jews and are not, but lie—look, I will make them come and bow down before your feet, and know that I have loved you.
verses.3:10: Because you kept the word of My endurance, I also will keep you from the hour of testing that is about to come upon the whole inhabited world, to test those who dwell on the earth.
verses.3:11: I am coming quickly. Hold fast what you have, so that no one may take your crown.
verses.3:12: The one who conquers, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will by no means go outside anymore, and I will write on him the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God, and My new name.
verses.3:13: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
verses.3:14: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea write: "These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God:
verses.3:15: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. If only you were cold or hot.
verses.3:16: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I am about to vomit you out of My mouth.
verses.3:17: Because you say, 'I am rich, and have grown wealthy, and have need of nothing,' and do not know that you are the one who is wretched and pitiable and poor and blind and naked,
verses.3:18: I advise you to buy from Me gold refined by fire so that you may become rich, and white garments so that you may clothe yourself and the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed, and eye salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
verses.3:19: As many as I love, I reprove and discipline. Be zealous, therefore, and repent.
verses.3:20: Look, I am standing at the door and knocking. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and eat supper with him, and he with Me.
verses.3:21: The one who conquers, I will grant him to sit with Me on My throne, just as I also conquered and sat down with My Father on His throne.
verses.3:22: The one who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."
verses.4:1: After these things I looked, and see, an open door in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was saying, "Come up here, and I will show you the things that must take place." After these things,
verses.4:2: immediately I was in the Spirit; and see, a throne was set in heaven, and on the throne One was sitting,
verses.4:3: and the One sitting was like a jasper stone and a carnelian in appearance, and a rainbow around the throne was like an emerald in appearance.
verses.4:4: And around the throne were twenty-four thrones, and on the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, clothed in white garments, and on their heads were golden crowns.
verses.4:5: And from the throne proceed flashes of lightning and voices and peals of thunder; and seven torches of fire are burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits of God,
verses.4:6: and before the throne is something like a sea of glass, like crystal. And in the center of the throne and around the throne are four living creatures, full of eyes in front and behind;
verses.4:7: and the first living creature is like a lion, and the second living creature is like a calf, and the third living creature has a face like that of a human being, and the fourth living creature is like a flying eagle;
verses.4:8: and the four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes all around and inside; and they have no rest day and night, saying, "Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, the One who was and the One who is and the One who is coming."
verses.4:9: And whenever the living creatures give glory and honor and thanksgiving to the One sitting on the throne, to the One living forever and ever,
verses.4:10: the twenty-four elders will fall down before the One sitting on the throne, and will worship the One living forever and ever, and will cast their crowns before the throne, saying,
verses.4:11: "Worthy are You, our Lord and our God, to receive the glory and the honor and the power, because You created all things, and on account of Your will they existed and were created."
verses.5:1: And I saw in the right hand of the One sitting on the throne a scroll written inside and on the back, sealed tightly with seven seals.
verses.5:2: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming in a loud voice, "Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?"
verses.5:3: And no one was able, in heaven or on the earth or under the earth, to open the scroll or to look at it.
verses.5:4: And I was weeping greatly because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or to look at it.
verses.5:5: And one of the elders said to me, "Stop weeping. Look, the Lion from the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has conquered so as to open the scroll and its seven seals."
verses.5:6: And I saw in the midst of the throne and the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing as though slaughtered, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
verses.5:7: And He came and took it from the right hand of the One sitting on the throne.
verses.5:8: And when He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp and gold bowls filled with incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
verses.5:9: And they sang a new song, saying, "You are worthy to take the scroll and to open its seals, because You were slaughtered and purchased us for God with Your blood from every tribe and language and people and nation,
verses.5:10: and You made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they will reign on the earth."
verses.5:11: And I looked, and I heard the voice of many angels around the throne and the living creatures and the elders, and their number was ten thousands of ten thousands and thousands of thousands,
verses.5:12: saying with a loud voice, "Worthy is the Lamb who was slaughtered to receive power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing."
verses.5:13: And I heard every created thing that is in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and on the sea, and all things in them, saying, "To the One sitting on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing and the honor and the glory and the dominion forever and ever."
verses.5:14: And the four living creatures were saying, "Amen." And the elders fell down and worshiped.
verses.6:1: And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as if with the voice of thunder, "Come!"
verses.6:2: And I saw, and look, a white horse, and the one sitting on it had a bow; and a crown was given to him, and he went out conquering and in order to conquer.
verses.6:3: And when He opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, "Come!"
verses.6:4: And another horse, fiery red, went out; and to the one sitting on it, it was given to take peace from the earth and so that they would slaughter one another, and a great sword was given to him.
verses.6:5: And when He opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, "Come!" And I saw, and look, a black horse, and the one sitting on it had a pair of scales in his hand.
verses.6:6: And I heard something like a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, "One quart of wheat for a denarius, and three quarts of barley for a denarius; and do not harm the oil and the wine."
verses.6:7: And when He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature saying, "Come!"
verses.6:8: And I saw, and look, a pale green horse; and the name of the one sitting on it was Death, and Hades was following with him. And authority was given to them over a fourth of the earth, to kill with sword and with famine and with pestilence, and by the wild beasts of the earth.
verses.6:9: And when He opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been slaughtered because of the word of God and because of the testimony they held.
verses.6:10: And they cried out with a loud voice, saying, "How long, Master, holy and true, will You not judge and avenge our blood against those who dwell on the earth?"
verses.6:11: And a white robe was given to each of them, and it was told to them that they should rest a little while longer, until both their fellow slaves and their brothers, who were about to be killed just as they also were, should be completed.
verses.6:12: And I saw when He opened the sixth seal, and a great earthquake occurred; and the sun became black like sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became like blood,
verses.6:13: and the stars of the sky fell to the earth, as a fig tree drops its unripe figs when shaken by a great wind,
verses.6:14: and the sky parted like a scroll being rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
verses.6:15: And the kings of the earth and the nobles and the commanders and the rich and the mighty, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and among the rocks of the mountains.
verses.6:16: And they say to the mountains and to the rocks, "Fall on us and hide us from the face of the One sitting on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb,
verses.6:17: because the great day of Their wrath has arrived, and who is able to stand?"
verses.7:1: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding back the four winds of the earth, so that no wind should blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor against any tree.
verses.7:2: And I saw another angel ascending from the rising of the sun, having the seal of the living God; and he cried out with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
verses.7:3: saying, "Do not harm the earth, nor the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads."
verses.7:4: And I heard the number of those who were sealed: one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed from every tribe of the sons of Israel:
verses.7:5: from the tribe of Judah, twelve thousand sealed; from the tribe of Reuben, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Gad, twelve thousand;
verses.7:6: from the tribe of Asher, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Naphtali, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Manasseh, twelve thousand;
verses.7:7: from the tribe of Simeon, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Levi, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Issachar, twelve thousand;
verses.7:8: from the tribe of Zebulun, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Joseph, twelve thousand; from the tribe of Benjamin, twelve thousand sealed.
verses.7:9: After these things I saw, and look, a great multitude that no one was able to count, from every nation and from tribes and peoples and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands;
verses.7:10: and they cry out with a loud voice, saying, "Salvation belongs to our God who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."
verses.7:11: And all the angels were standing around the throne and the elders and the four living creatures, and they fell before the throne on their faces and worshiped God,
verses.7:12: saying, "Amen! Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanksgiving and honor and power and strength belong to our God forever and ever. Amen."
verses.7:13: And one of the elders responded, saying to me, "These who are clothed in the white robes—who are they, and where did they come from?"
verses.7:14: And I said to him, "My lord, you know." And he said to me, "These are the ones coming out of the great tribulation, and they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.
verses.7:15: For this reason they are before the throne of God, and they serve Him day and night in His temple; and He who sits on the throne will spread His tent over them.
verses.7:16: They will not hunger anymore, nor thirst anymore; neither will the sun ever fall on them, nor any scorching heat,
verses.7:17: because the Lamb in the center of the throne will shepherd them and will guide them to springs of the waters of life; and God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
verses.8:1: And when He opened the seventh seal, there came silence in heaven for about half an hour.
verses.8:2: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and to them were given seven trumpets.
verses.8:3: And another angel came and stood at the altar, holding a golden censer; and much incense was given to him so that he would offer it with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar that is before the throne.
verses.8:4: And the smoke of the incense went up with the prayers of the saints from the hand of the angel before God.
verses.8:5: And the angel took the censer and filled it from the fire of the altar and threw it to the earth; and there came peals of thunder and sounds and flashes of lightning and an earthquake.
verses.8:6: And the seven angels who had the seven trumpets made themselves ready to sound them.
verses.8:7: And the first sounded his trumpet; and there came hail and fire, mixed with blood, and it was thrown to the earth; and a third of the earth was burned up, and a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
verses.8:8: And the second angel sounded his trumpet; and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea, and a third of the sea became blood,
verses.8:9: and a third of the creatures in the sea, those having life, died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
verses.8:10: And the third angel sounded his trumpet; and a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and it fell upon a third of the rivers and upon the springs of the waters.
verses.8:11: And the name of the star is called Wormwood. And a third of the waters turned into wormwood, and many of the people died from the waters, because they had been made bitter.
verses.8:12: And the fourth angel sounded his trumpet; and a third of the sun was struck, and a third of the moon, and a third of the stars, so that a third of them would be darkened, and the day would not shine for a third of it, and the night likewise.
verses.8:13: And I looked, and I heard an eagle flying in midheaven, saying with a loud voice, "Woe, woe, woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the remaining sounds of the trumpet of the three angels who are about to sound their trumpets!"
verses.9:1: And the fifth angel sounded the trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to the earth, and the key to the shaft of the abyss was given to him.
verses.9:2: And he opened the shaft of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the shaft like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened from the smoke of the shaft.
verses.9:3: And out of the smoke locusts came out onto the earth, and power was given to them like the power the scorpions of the earth have.
verses.9:4: And it was told to them not to harm the grass of the earth, nor any green thing, nor any tree, but only the people who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
verses.9:5: And it was given to them not to kill them, but that they would be tormented for five months; and their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
verses.9:6: And in those days people will seek death and will by no means find it, and they will long to die, and death flees from them.
verses.9:7: And the forms of the locusts were like horses prepared for battle, and on their heads were what looked like crowns resembling gold, and their faces were like the faces of human beings,
verses.9:8: and they had hair like the hair of women, and their teeth were like those of lions,
verses.9:9: and they had breastplates like iron breastplates, and the sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots with many horses running into battle.
verses.9:10: And they have tails like those of scorpions, and stingers, and in their tails is their power to harm people for five months.
verses.9:11: They have as king over them the angel of the abyss; his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he has the name Apollyon.
verses.9:12: The first woe has passed; look, two woes are still coming after these things.
verses.9:13: And the sixth angel sounded the trumpet, and I heard one voice from the horns of the golden altar that is before God,
verses.9:14: saying to the sixth angel, the one holding the trumpet, "Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates."
verses.9:15: And the four angels were released, who had been prepared for the hour and day and month and year, to kill a third of humanity.
verses.9:16: And the number of the armies of the cavalry was two hundred million; I heard their number.
verses.9:17: And this is how I saw the horses in the vision and those sitting on them, having fiery, hyacinth-blue, and sulfurous breastplates; and the heads of the horses were like heads of lions, and out of their mouths come fire and smoke and sulfur.
verses.9:18: By these three plagues a third of humanity was killed, by the fire and the smoke and the sulfur coming out of their mouths.
verses.9:19: For the power of the horses is in their mouth and in their tails; for their tails are like serpents, having heads, and with them they do harm.
verses.9:20: And the rest of humanity, who were not killed by these plagues, did not even repent of the works of their hands so that they would not worship demons and the idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which can neither see nor hear nor walk,
verses.9:21: and they did not repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.
verses.10:1: And I saw another strong angel descending from heaven, wrapped in a cloud, and the rainbow was on his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet were like pillars of fire,
verses.10:2: and he had in his hand an open little scroll. And he set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the earth,
verses.10:3: and he cried out with a loud voice, just as a lion roars. And when he cried out, the seven thunders spoke with their own voices.
verses.10:4: And when the seven thunders spoke, I was about to write; and I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Seal up the things that the seven thunders spoke, and do not write them."
verses.10:5: And the angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the earth raised his right hand toward heaven,
verses.10:6: and swore by Him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and what is in it, and the earth and what is in it, and the sea and what is in it, that there will no longer be delay,
verses.10:7: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to blow the trumpet, then the mystery of God will be completed, just as He announced the good news to His own servants the prophets.
verses.10:8: And the voice that I heard from heaven was speaking with me again and saying, "Go, take the scroll that is open in the hand of the angel who is standing on the sea and on the earth."
verses.10:9: And I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little scroll. And he said to me, "Take it and eat it up, and it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey."
verses.10:10: And I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it up, and in my mouth it was sweet as honey; and when I had eaten it, my stomach became bitter.
verses.10:11: And they said to me, "You must prophesy again concerning peoples and nations and languages and many kings."
verses.11:1: And a reed like a staff was given to me, and someone said, "Rise and measure the temple of God and the altar and those who worship in it.
verses.11:2: But leave out the court that is outside the temple and do not measure it, because it was given to the nations, and they will trample the holy city for forty-two months.
verses.11:3: And I will grant it to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy for one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth."
verses.11:4: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand before the Lord of the earth.
verses.11:5: And if anyone desires to harm them, fire comes out from their mouth and devours their enemies; and if anyone should desire to harm them, in this way he must be killed.
verses.11:6: These have the authority to shut the sky so that rain will not fall during the days of their prophecy, and they have authority over the waters to turn them into blood and to strike the earth with every plague as often as they desire.
verses.11:7: And when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war against them and conquer them and kill them.
verses.11:8: And their corpse will lie on the street of the great city, which is spiritually called Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord also was crucified.
verses.11:9: And some from the peoples and tribes and languages and nations look at their corpse for three and a half days, and they do not permit their corpses to be placed in a tomb.
verses.11:10: And those who dwell on the earth rejoice over them and celebrate, and they will send gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
verses.11:11: And after the three and a half days, a breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet, and great fear fell upon those who were watching them.
verses.11:12: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, "Come up here," and they went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies watched them.
verses.11:13: And in that hour a great earthquake occurred, and a tenth of the city fell, and seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake; and the rest became terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.11:14: The second woe has passed; look, the third woe is coming quickly.
verses.11:15: And the seventh angel blew his trumpet, and there were loud voices in heaven, saying, "The kingdom of the world has become our Lord's and His Christ's, and He will reign forever and ever."
verses.11:16: And the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God, fell on their faces and worshiped God,
verses.11:17: saying, "We give thanks to You, Lord God, the Almighty, the One who is and who was, and because You have taken Your great power and begun to reign.
verses.11:18: And the nations were enraged, and Your wrath came, and the time for the dead to be judged, and to give the reward to Your servants the prophets and to the saints and to those who fear Your name, the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth."
verses.11:19: And the temple of God that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant was seen in His temple; and there were flashes of lightning and sounds and peals of thunder and an earthquake and heavy hail.
verses.12:1: And a great sign appeared in heaven: a woman clothed in the sun, and the moon beneath her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars;
verses.12:2: and she was pregnant, and she was crying out in labor pains and in agony to give birth.
verses.12:3: And another sign appeared in heaven, and look, a great fiery-red dragon having seven heads and ten horns, and upon his heads seven diadems;
verses.12:4: and his tail dragged away a third of the stars of heaven and cast them to the earth. And the dragon stood in front of the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
verses.12:5: And she gave birth to a son, a male, who is to shepherd all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was snatched up to God and to His throne.
verses.12:6: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, so that there they might nourish her for one thousand two hundred sixty days.
verses.12:7: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon, and the dragon and his angels fought,
verses.12:8: and they did not prevail, nor was a place found for them any longer in heaven.
verses.12:9: And the great dragon was cast down, the ancient serpent, who is called the Devil and Satan, the one deceiving the whole inhabited world; he was cast to the earth, and his angels were cast down with him.
verses.12:10: And I heard a loud voice in heaven saying, "Now salvation and power and the kingdom of our God and the authority of His Christ have arrived, because the accuser of our brothers has been cast down, the one accusing them before our God day and night.
verses.12:11: And they conquered him because of the blood of the Lamb and because of the word of their testimony, and they did not love their life even to the point of death.
verses.12:12: Because of this, rejoice, heavens and those dwelling in them! Woe to the earth and the sea, because the devil has come down to you, having great fury, knowing that he has a short time."
verses.12:13: And when the dragon saw that he had been cast to the earth, he pursued the woman who gave birth to the male child.
verses.12:14: And two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, so that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, where she is nourished for a time and times and half a time, away from the presence of the serpent.
verses.12:15: And the serpent cast water like a river out of his mouth after the woman, so that he might cause her to be swept away by the river.
verses.12:16: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river that the dragon had cast out of his mouth.
verses.12:17: And the dragon became enraged at the woman, and went off to wage war against the rest of her offspring, those who keep the commandments of God and hold the testimony of Jesus.
verses.12:18: And he stood upon the sand of the sea.
verses.13:1: And I saw a beast rising out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on its horns ten diadems, and on its heads a name of blasphemy.
verses.13:2: And the beast that I saw was like a leopard, and its feet were like those of a bear, and its mouth was like a lion's mouth. And the dragon gave to it its power and its throne and great authority.
verses.13:3: And one of its heads appeared as though slain to death, and its fatal wound was healed. And the whole earth marveled after the beast,
verses.13:4: and they worshiped the dragon because it gave the authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, "Who is like the beast, and who is able to wage war with it?"
verses.13:5: And a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies was given to it, and authority was given to it to act for forty-two months.
verses.13:6: And it opened its mouth in blasphemies against God, to blaspheme His name and His dwelling, those who dwell in heaven.
verses.13:7: And it was given to it to make war with the saints and to conquer them, and authority was given to it over every tribe and people and language and nation.
verses.13:8: And all who dwell on the earth will worship it, everyone whose name has not been written in the book of life of the Lamb who was slain from the foundation of the world.
verses.13:9: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.
verses.13:10: If anyone is for captivity, he goes away; if anyone kills with the sword, with the sword he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.
verses.13:11: And I saw another beast rising out of the earth, and it had two horns like a lamb, and it spoke like a dragon.
verses.13:12: And it exercises all the authority of the first beast in its presence. And it makes the earth and those who dwell in it worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.
verses.13:13: And it performs great signs, so that it even makes fire come down out of heaven to the earth in the sight of people.
verses.13:14: And it deceives those who dwell on the earth because of the signs that were given to it to perform in the presence of the beast, telling those who dwell on the earth to make an image for the beast that has the wound of the sword and lived.
verses.13:15: And it was given to it to give breath to the image of the beast, so that the image of the beast would even speak and cause as many as do not worship the image of the beast to be killed.
verses.13:16: And it causes everyone, the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the enslaved, to be given a mark on their right hand or on their forehead,
verses.13:17: and so that no one may be able to buy or to sell except the one who has the mark, the name of the beast or the number of its name.
verses.13:18: Here is wisdom: let the one who has understanding calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a human being, and its number is six hundred sixty-six.
verses.14:1: And I saw, and look, the Lamb was standing on Mount Zion, and with Him one hundred forty-four thousand, having His name and the name of His Father written on their foreheads.
verses.14:2: And I heard a sound from heaven like the sound of many waters and like the sound of mighty thunder, and the sound that I heard was like harpists playing on their harps.
verses.14:3: And they sing a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders; and no one was able to learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been purchased from the earth.
verses.14:4: These are the ones who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are the ones who follow the Lamb wherever He goes. These were purchased from mankind as firstfruits to God and to the Lamb,
verses.14:5: and in their mouth no falsehood was found, for they are blameless.
verses.14:6: And I saw another angel flying in midheaven, having an eternal gospel to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth, and to every nation and tribe and tongue and people,
verses.14:7: saying in a loud voice, "Fear God and give Him glory, because the hour of His judgment has come; and worship the One who made heaven and earth and sea and springs of waters."
verses.14:8: And another, a second angel, followed, saying, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, she who has made all the nations drink from the wine of the fury of her sexual immorality."
verses.14:9: And another angel, a third, followed them, saying in a loud voice, "If anyone worships the beast and its image, and receives a mark on his forehead or on his hand,
verses.14:10: he also will drink from the wine of the fury of God, which has been mixed undiluted in the cup of His wrath; and he will be tormented in fire and sulfur before holy angels and before the Lamb.
verses.14:11: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever, and they have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and its image, and anyone who receives the mark of its name."
verses.14:12: Here is the endurance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.
verses.14:13: And I heard a voice from heaven saying, "Write: 'Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.'" "Yes," says the Spirit, "so that they will rest from their labors, for their deeds follow with them."
verses.14:14: And I saw, and look, a white cloud, and sitting on the cloud was One like a son of man, having a golden crown on His head and a sharp sickle in His hand.
verses.14:15: And another angel came out from the temple, calling out in a loud voice to the One sitting on the cloud, "Send out Your sickle and reap, because the hour to reap has come, for the harvest of the earth is ripe."
verses.14:16: And the One sitting on the cloud cast His sickle upon the earth, and the earth was reaped.
verses.14:17: And another angel came out from the temple that is in heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.
verses.14:18: And another angel came out from the altar, the one having authority over the fire, and he called out with a loud voice to the one having the sharp sickle, saying, "Send out your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, because its grapes have ripened."
verses.14:19: And the angel cast his sickle into the earth and gathered the vine of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the fury of God.
verses.14:20: And the winepress was trodden outside the city, and blood came out from the winepress up to the bridles of the horses, for a distance of one thousand six hundred stadia.
verses.15:1: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvelous: seven angels having seven plagues, the last ones, because in them the wrath of God is completed.
verses.15:2: And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who were victorious over the beast and over its image and over the number of its name, standing on the sea of glass, holding harps of God.
verses.15:3: And they sing the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, "Great and marvelous are Your works, Lord God, the Almighty; righteous and true are Your ways, King of the ages.
verses.15:4: Who will not fear, Lord, and glorify Your name, since You alone are holy? For all the nations will come and worship before You, because Your righteous deeds have been revealed."
verses.15:5: And after these things I looked, and the sanctuary of the tent of testimony in heaven was opened,
verses.15:6: and the seven angels having the seven plagues came out of the sanctuary, clothed in pure, bright linen and wrapped around their chests with golden sashes.
verses.15:7: And one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels seven golden bowls filled with the wrath of God, the One who lives forever and ever.
verses.15:8: And the sanctuary was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power, and no one was able to enter the sanctuary until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
verses.16:1: And I heard a loud voice out of the sanctuary saying to the seven angels, "Go and pour out the seven bowls of the fury of God onto the earth."
verses.16:2: And the first went away and poured out his bowl onto the earth, and a harmful and malignant sore came upon the people who had the mark of the beast and who worshiped its image.
verses.16:3: And the second poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood like that of a dead person, and every living creature died, everything in the sea.
verses.16:4: And the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and the springs of the waters, and they became blood.
verses.16:5: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, "You are righteous, the One who is and who was, the Holy One, because You judged these things,
verses.16:6: for they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and You gave them blood to drink; they are deserving of it."
verses.16:7: And I heard the altar saying, "Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, Your judgments are true and righteous."
verses.16:8: And the fourth poured out his bowl upon the sun, and it was permitted to scorch people with fire.
verses.16:9: And the people were scorched with great heat, and they blasphemed the name of God, who has the authority over these plagues, and they did not repent so as to give Him glory.
verses.16:10: And the fifth poured out his bowl upon the throne of the beast, and its kingdom became darkened, and they were gnawing their tongues because of the pain,
verses.16:11: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and because of their sores, and they did not repent of their works.
verses.16:12: And the sixth poured out his bowl upon the great river Euphrates, and its water was dried up, so that the way of the kings from the rising of the sun might be prepared.
verses.16:13: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs coming out of the mouth of the dragon and out of the mouth of the beast and out of the mouth of the false prophet;
verses.16:14: for they are spirits of demons performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited world to gather them for the battle of the great day of God the Almighty—
verses.16:15: "Look, I am coming like a thief. Blessed is the one who stays awake and guards his garments, so that he may not walk around naked and they see his shame."—
verses.16:16: and they gathered them into the place called in Hebrew Armageddon.
verses.16:17: And the seventh poured out his bowl into the air—and a loud voice came out of the sanctuary from the throne, saying, "It is done!"—
verses.16:18: and there were flashes of lightning and voices and peals of thunder, and a great earthquake occurred, such as had not occurred since people came to be on the earth, an earthquake so immense, so great.
verses.16:19: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell; and Babylon the great was remembered before God, to give her the cup of the wine of the fury of His wrath.
verses.16:20: And every island fled, and mountains were not found.
verses.16:21: And great hail, about a talent in weight, came down out of heaven upon the people; and the people blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, because its plague was extremely great.
verses.17:1: And one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, "Come here; I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits upon many waters,
verses.17:2: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who inhabit the earth were made drunk from the wine of her sexual immorality."
verses.17:3: And he carried me away into a wilderness in the Spirit. And I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
verses.17:4: And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls, holding a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and the unclean things of her sexual immorality,
verses.17:5: and on her forehead a name was written, a mystery: "Babylon the Great, the Mother of the Prostitutes and of the Abominations of the Earth."
verses.17:6: And I saw the woman drunk from the blood of the saints and from the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. And when I saw her, I marveled with great astonishment.
verses.17:7: And the angel said to me, "Why did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns:
verses.17:8: The beast that you saw was, and is not, and is about to ascend out of the abyss and go to destruction. And those who dwell on the earth, whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, will marvel when they see the beast, because it was, and is not, and will be present.
verses.17:9: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits, and they are seven kings:
verses.17:10: five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come, and when he comes, he must remain a little while.
verses.17:11: And as for the beast that was, and is not, it also is an eighth, and is one of the seven, and goes to destruction.
verses.17:12: And the ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom, but they receive authority as kings for one hour with the beast.
verses.17:13: These have one purpose, and they give their power and their authority to the beast.
verses.17:14: These will wage war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will conquer them, because He is Lord of lords and King of kings, and those with Him are called and chosen and faithful."
verses.17:15: And he says to me, "The waters that you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples and crowds and nations and languages.
verses.17:16: And the ten horns that you saw and the beast—these will hate the prostitute, and make her desolate and naked, and eat her flesh, and burn her up with fire;
verses.17:17: for God put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose, and to act with one purpose, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God are fulfilled.
verses.17:18: And the woman whom you saw is the great city that holds kingship over the kings of the earth."
verses.18:1: After these things I saw another angel descending out of heaven, having great authority, and the earth was illuminated by his glory.
verses.18:2: And he cried out with a mighty voice, saying, "Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great! And she has become a dwelling place of demons, a prison for every unclean spirit, and a prison for every unclean and hated bird,
verses.18:3: because from the wine of the passion of her sexual immorality all the nations have fallen, and the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the power of her luxury."
verses.18:4: And I heard another voice out of heaven, saying, "Come out of her, My people, so that you do not participate in her sins and so that you do not receive any of her plagues;
verses.18:5: for her sins have piled up all the way to heaven, and God has remembered her wrongdoings.
verses.18:6: Pay her back just as she herself paid, and pay back double according to her deeds; in the cup that she mixed, mix a double portion for her.
verses.18:7: As much as she glorified herself and lived in luxury, give her that same measure of torment and mourning. For in her heart she says, 'I sit as a queen, and I am not a widow, and I will never see mourning.'
verses.18:8: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death and mourning and famine; and she will be burned up with fire, for mighty is the Lord God who has judged her.
verses.18:9: And the kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived in luxury with her, will weep and wail over her when they see the smoke of her burning,
verses.18:10: standing at a distance because of the fear of her torment, saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the mighty city! For in one hour your judgment has come.'
verses.18:11: And the merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, because no one buys their cargo anymore,
verses.18:12: cargo of gold and silver and precious stones and pearls and fine linen and purple and silk and scarlet, and every kind of citron wood and every article of ivory and every article made of most costly wood and bronze and iron and marble,
verses.18:13: and cinnamon and spice and incense and perfume and frankincense and wine and olive oil and fine flour and wheat and cattle and sheep, and horses and carriages and slaves, and human souls.
verses.18:14: And the ripe fruit of your soul's desire has departed from you, and all the sumptuous and splendid things have perished from you, and they will never find them again.
verses.18:15: The merchants of these things, who grew rich from her, will stand at a distance because of the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning,
verses.18:16: saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, she who was clothed in fine linen and purple and scarlet, and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls,
verses.18:17: for in one hour such great wealth has been laid waste!' And every shipmaster and everyone who sails to any place, and sailors and all who work the sea, stood at a distance
verses.18:18: and were crying out as they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, 'What city is like the great city?'
verses.18:19: And they threw dust on their heads and were crying out, weeping and mourning, saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had ships on the sea grew rich from her wealth, for in one hour she has been laid waste!'
verses.18:20: Rejoice over her, heaven, and you saints and apostles and prophets, for God has rendered judgment for you against her."
verses.18:21: And a mighty angel lifted up a stone like a great millstone and threw it into the sea, saying, "In this way, with violence, Babylon, the great city, will be thrown down, and will never be found again.
verses.18:22: And the sound of harpists and musicians and flute players and trumpeters will never be heard in you again, and no craftsman of any craft will ever be found in you again, and the sound of a mill will never be heard in you again,
verses.18:23: and the light of a lamp will never shine in you again, and the voice of bridegroom and bride will never be heard in you again; for your merchants were the magnates of the earth, because by your sorcery all the nations were deceived,
verses.18:24: and in her was found the blood of prophets and saints, and of all who have been slaughtered on the earth."
verses.19:1: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great crowd in heaven, saying, "Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
verses.19:2: because His judgments are true and righteous; for He judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and He avenged the blood of His slaves from her hand."
verses.19:3: And a second time they said, "Hallelujah! And her smoke rises forever and ever."
verses.19:4: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who is seated on the throne, saying, "Amen, Hallelujah!"
verses.19:5: And a voice came out from the throne, saying, "Praise our God, all His slaves, and those who fear Him, the small and the great."
verses.19:6: And I heard something like the voice of a great crowd, and like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of mighty peals of thunder, saying, "Hallelujah, because the Lord, our God, the Almighty, has begun to reign.
verses.19:7: Let us rejoice and exult, and give the glory to Him, because the wedding of the Lamb has come, and His wife has prepared herself,
verses.19:8: and it was granted to her to clothe herself in fine linen, bright and pure." For the fine linen is the righteous deeds of the saints.
verses.19:9: And he said to me, "Write: 'Blessed are those who have been invited to the wedding supper of the Lamb.'" And he said to me, "These are the true words of God."
verses.19:10: And I fell before his feet to worship him. And he said to me, "See that you do not! I am a fellow slave of yours and of your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God! For the testimony of Jesus is the spirit of prophecy."
verses.19:11: And I saw heaven opened, and look, a white horse! And the One seated on it is called Faithful and True, and in righteousness He judges and wages war.
verses.19:12: And His eyes are a flame of fire, and on His head are many diadems, and He has a name written that no one knows except Himself.
verses.19:13: And He is clothed in a garment dipped in blood, and His name has been called the Word of God.
verses.19:14: And the armies in heaven were following Him on white horses, dressed in fine linen, white and pure.
verses.19:15: And from His mouth comes a sharp sword, so that with it He may strike the nations, and He Himself will shepherd them with an iron rod; and He Himself treads the winepress of the wine of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
verses.19:16: And He has a name written on His garment and on His thigh: "King of kings and Lord of lords."
verses.19:17: And I saw one angel standing in the sun, and he cried out with a loud voice, saying to all the birds flying in midheaven, "Come, gather together for the great supper of God,
verses.19:18: so that you may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of military commanders, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those seated on them, and the flesh of all, both free and slave, and small and great."
verses.19:19: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to make war against the One seated on the horse and against His army.
verses.19:20: And the beast was captured, and with it the false prophet who performed the signs in its presence, by which he deceived those who received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped its image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.
verses.19:21: And the rest were killed with the sword of the One seated on the horse, which came out of His mouth, and all the birds were filled with their flesh.
verses.20:1: And I saw an angel descending from heaven, holding the key to the abyss and a large chain in his hand.
verses.20:2: And he seized the dragon, the ancient serpent, who is the Devil and Satan, and bound him for a thousand years.
verses.20:3: And he threw him into the abyss, and shut it and sealed it over him, so that he would no longer deceive the nations until the thousand years were finished. After these things he must be released for a short time.
verses.20:4: And I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. And I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded because of the testimony of Jesus and because of the word of God, and those who did not worship the beast or its image and did not receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. And they came to life and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.
verses.20:5: The rest of the dead did not come to life until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
verses.20:6: Blessed and holy is the one who has a share in the first resurrection. Over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with Him for the thousand years.
verses.20:7: And when the thousand years are finished, Satan will be released from his prison,
verses.20:8: and will go out to deceive the nations that are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together for the battle; their number is like the sand of the sea.
verses.20:9: And they went up over the breadth of the earth and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city. And fire came down from heaven and devoured them.
verses.20:10: And the Devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet also are, and they will be tormented day and night forever and ever.
verses.20:11: And I saw a great white throne and the One seated on it, from whose presence earth and heaven fled, and no place was found for them.
verses.20:12: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is the book of life. And the dead were judged from the things written in the books, according to their works.
verses.20:13: And the sea gave up the dead who were in it, and Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them, and they were judged, each one according to their works.
verses.20:14: And Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.
verses.20:15: And if anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
verses.21:1: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and the first earth passed away, and the sea exists no longer.
verses.21:2: And I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.21:3: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying, "Look, the dwelling of God is with people, and He will dwell with them, and they will be His peoples, and God Himself will be with them,
verses.21:4: and He will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death will exist no longer; neither mourning nor crying nor pain will exist any longer. The first things have passed away."
verses.21:5: And the One seated on the throne said, "Look, I am making all things new." And He said to me, "Write, for these words are faithful and true."
verses.21:6: And He said to me, "They have come to pass. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give to the one who thirsts from the spring of the water of life without cost.
verses.21:7: The one who overcomes will inherit these things, and I will be God to him, and he will be a son to Me.
verses.21:8: But as for the cowardly and unbelieving and detestable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their share is in the lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is the second death."
verses.21:9: And there came one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, full of the seven last plagues, and he spoke with me, saying, "Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb."
verses.21:10: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and he showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,
verses.21:11: having the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious stone, like a jasper stone, clear as crystal.
verses.21:12: It had a great and high wall; it had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are those of the twelve tribes of the sons of Israel:
verses.21:13: on the east three gates, and on the north three gates, and on the south three gates, and on the west three gates.
verses.21:14: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them were twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.21:15: And the one speaking with me had a golden measuring reed, so that he might measure the city and its gates and its wall.
verses.21:16: And the city is laid out as a square, and its length is the same as its width. And he measured the city with the reed at twelve thousand stadia; its length and width and height are equal.
verses.21:17: And he measured its wall at one hundred forty-four cubits, a human measurement, which is an angel's.
verses.21:18: And the structure of its wall was jasper, and the city was pure gold, like clear glass.
verses.21:19: The foundations of the wall of the city were adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,
verses.21:20: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, the twelfth amethyst.
verses.21:21: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; each one of the gates was made of a single pearl. And the street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.
verses.21:22: And I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God the Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb.
verses.21:23: And the city has no need of the sun nor of the moon to shine upon it, because the glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.
verses.21:24: And the nations will walk by its light, and the kings of the earth bring their glory into it.
verses.21:25: And its gates will by no means be closed by day, for there will be no night there.
verses.21:26: And they will bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it.
verses.21:27: And nothing unclean will ever enter into it, nor anyone who practices a detestable thing and a lie, but only those who are written in the book of life of the Lamb.
verses.22:1: And he showed me a river of the water of life, bright as crystal, flowing out from the throne of God and of the Lamb
verses.22:2: in the middle of its street. And on this side and on that side of the river was the tree of life, producing twelve fruits, yielding its fruit each month; and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.22:3: And there will be no curse any longer. And the throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and His servants will serve Him,
verses.22:4: and they will see His face, and His name will be upon their foreheads.
verses.22:5: And there will be no night any longer, and they have no need of the light of a lamp or of the light of the sun, because the Lord God will shine upon them; and they will reign forever and ever.
verses.22:6: And he said to me, "These words are faithful and true, and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent His angel to show His servants the things that must happen soon;
verses.22:7: and look, I am coming quickly. Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book."
verses.22:8: And I, John, am the one hearing and seeing these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who was showing me these things.
verses.22:9: And he said to me, "Do not do that! I am a fellow servant of yours and of your brothers the prophets and of those who keep the words of this book. Worship God."
verses.22:10: And he said to me, "Do not seal the words of the prophecy of this book, because the time is near.
verses.22:11: Let the one who acts unjustly still act unjustly, and let the filthy one still be defiled, and let the righteous one still do righteousness, and let the holy one still be made holy."
verses.22:12: "Look, I am coming quickly, and My reward is with Me, to repay each one according to what his work is.
verses.22:13: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.
verses.22:14: Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they will have the right to the tree of life and may enter through the gates into the city.
verses.22:15: Outside are the dogs and the sorcerers and the sexually immoral and the murderers and the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices a lie.
verses.22:16: I, Jesus, sent My angel to testify these things to you for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright morning star."
verses.22:17: And the Spirit and the bride say, "Come." And let the one who hears say, "Come." And let the one who is thirsty come; let the one who desires take the water of life freely.
verses.22:18: I myself testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book: if anyone adds to these things, God will add to him the plagues written in this book;
verses.22:19: and if anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, God will take away his share from the tree of life and out of the holy city, the things written in this book.
verses.22:20: The One who testifies to these things says, "Yes, I am coming quickly." Amen. Come, Lord Jesus.
verses.22:21: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with all.

notes.1:4: The Greek deliberately places the divine title "the One who is and who was and who is coming" in the nominative case after the preposition "from" (which normally takes the genitive), treating it as an indeclinable divine name echoing Exodus 3:14. "The seven spirits" is variously understood as the sevenfold fullness of the Holy Spirit (cf. Isaiah 11:2) or seven heavenly spirits before God's throne.
notes.1:5: The Greek text reads lysanti ("freed" or "released"), attested by the earliest manuscripts, whereas later manuscripts read lousanti ("washed"), a variant arising from their identical pronunciation in Koine Greek.
notes.1:10: "The Lord's day" (he kyriake hemera) is the sole occurrence of this phrase in the New Testament and is widely understood as Sunday, the weekly commemoration of Christ's resurrection, though some interpreters view it as a reference to the eschatological Day of the Lord.
notes.1:15: The rare Greek term chalkolibanon ("fine bronze"), found only here and in 2:18, refers to a gleaming copper or brass alloy whose exact composition is uncertain. The following participle pepyromenes ("fired") appears in the feminine genitive singular, creating a notable grammatical mismatch with the masculine plural "feet" and neuter dative "bronze."
notes.1:20: The Greek word angeloi can mean either "angels" or "messengers." Interpreters debate whether the angels of the seven churches are heavenly beings representing each congregation, human leaders or envoys, or symbolic personifications of the churches themselves.
notes.2:1: Greek angelos literally means "messenger" or "angel"; interpreters debate whether it refers to a heavenly representative of each church or a human messenger or leader.
notes.2:13: The Greek text places "Antipas" abruptly in the nominative case without a relative pronoun ("in the days [of] Antipas"), a characteristic grammatical feature of Revelation. "My faith" can mean either faith in Christ or faithfulness to Him.
notes.2:18: Greek chalkolibanos ("burnished bronze") is a rare word denoting an uncertain luminous metal alloy, likely fine bronze or brass glowing in a furnace.
notes.2:22: Literally "onto a bed," generally understood as a bed of sickness or suffering in ironic contrast to a bed of immorality. The Greek text specifically reads "her works" rather than "their works."
notes.2:23: "With death" reflects a Septuagint idiom (en thanato) frequently used for deadly pestilence or plague. "Minds and hearts" literally renders "kidneys and hearts," the biblical idiom for innermost thoughts, desires, and motives.
notes.3:4: Literally "names," a biblical idiom referring to individual persons (cf. Acts 1:15).
notes.3:5: The critical text reads οὕτως ("thus / in this way"), tying the promise directly to the white clothing of 3:4, whereas some manuscripts read οὗτος ("this one").
notes.3:9: The Greek clause breaks off after the partitive "I am giving some from the synagogue of Satan" and resumes after the description with "look, I will make them..."
notes.3:10: "The word of My endurance" can refer to Christ's message calling for endurance or the message exemplified by His own endurance; "keep you from" (τηρήσω ἐκ) is likewise debated between preservation through the trial and protection out of it.
notes.3:14: The Greek term ἀρχή ("beginning") is debated and can denote the active origin/source of God's creation, the ruler over creation, or its starting point.
notes.4:1: The Greek source punctuates a period before "After these things" (μετὰ ταῦτα), beginning the sentence that continues in 4:2; many editions instead attach the phrase to the end of the voice's speech ("what must take place after these things").
notes.4:2: Greek ἐν πνεύματι lacks the article (literally "in spirit") and refers either to being moved by the Holy Spirit or to entering a visionary spiritual state (cf. 1:10).
notes.4:6: The phrase "in the center of the throne and around the throne" (ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου) is spatially difficult, likely describing the four creatures positioned around the middle of each side of the throne.
notes.4:9: In 4:9-10 the Greek pairs ὅταν ("whenever") with future indicative verbs ("will fall down... will worship... will cast"), a characteristic idiom in Revelation expressing repeated, ongoing action.
notes.4:11: Greek ἦσαν καὶ ἐκτίσθησαν ("they existed and were created") has a notable textual history (some manuscripts read "they are" or "they did not exist"); the order likely expresses that all things have their being and were brought into creation solely by God's will.
notes.5:1: Greek "epi ten dexian" is literally "upon the right hand," picturing the scroll resting on the open palm; a scroll written inside and on the back (an opisthograph) suggests complete, unalterable contents.
notes.5:6: The repeated phrase "en meso" ("in the midst of") can situate the Lamb either in the center of the concentric scene or between the throne and living creatures on one side and the elders on the other. "The seven spirits of God" is understood either as the sevenfold fullness of the Holy Spirit or as seven angelic spirits before God's throne.
notes.5:9: The source text includes "hemas" ("us") here while reading "autous" ("them") and "basileusousin" ("they will reign") in 5:10; other manuscripts smooth this shift by omitting "hemas" in 5:9 or reading first-person plural forms in 5:10.
notes.5:11: Greek "myriades myriadon" uses "myrias" (literally "ten thousand") in the plural to express an uncountable multitude.
notes.5:13: "Forever and ever" translates the Greek idiom "eis tous aionas ton aionon," literally "to the ages of the ages."
notes.6:1: The summons "Come!" (Greek erchou) here and in verses 3, 5, and 7 is addressed to the emerging horsemen rather than to John; later manuscripts add "and see," which is absent from the earliest witnesses.
notes.6:6: "Quart" translates Greek choinix (about one liter, a single day's grain ration), and a denarius was a typical day's wage for a laborer, depicting extreme famine prices.
notes.6:8: "Pale green" (Greek chloros) describes a sickly greenish-yellow pallor. "Pestilence" translates Greek thanatos (literally "death"), reflecting the Septuagint rendering of Hebrew deber ("plague" or "pestilence," as in Ezekiel 14:21).
notes.6:11: "Should be completed" renders the Greek passive verb plerothosin, referring to the full number of fellow martyrs being reached without an explicit noun for "number" in the text.
notes.6:17: The critical text reads the plural "Their wrath" (auton), referring jointly to the One sitting on the throne and the Lamb, whereas some manuscripts read the singular "His wrath."
notes.7:5: This list of tribes in 7:5-8 is unique in Scripture: Judah is placed first, Levi and Joseph are counted alongside Manasseh, and Dan is omitted. In the Greek text, the participle "sealed" appears only on the first entry (Judah) and the last entry (Benjamin).
notes.7:9: The Greek exhibits characteristic Johannine syntax, shifting from the nominative participle "standing" to the accusative "clothed," and moving from singular "every nation" to plural "tribes and peoples and languages."
notes.7:14: "My lord" (kyrie mou) is a respectful address to the elder rather than a divine title. The present participle "coming out" (hoi erchomenoi) can carry either an ongoing sense or a general identifying sense ("those who come out").
notes.7:15: "Will spread His tent over them" renders skenosei ep' autous, literally "will tabernacle (or pitch a tent) over them," recalling God's sheltering presence with Israel in the wilderness.
notes.7:17: The Greek fronts "of life" for emphasis in "springs of the waters of life" (zoes pegas hydaton), using the plural "waters." The phrase "in the center of the throne" (ana meson tou thronou) places the Lamb within the throne's immediate space, echoing 5:6.
notes.8:3: Greek libanoton ("censer") elsewhere denotes frankincense, but here and in 8:5 refers to a golden incense pan or censer. The clause "that he would offer it with the prayers" is literally "that he will give to the prayers," indicating either adding the incense to the prayers or offering it alongside them.
notes.8:7: The clause "and a third of the earth was burned up" is strongly supported by the earliest manuscripts, though omitted in some later Byzantine witnesses.
notes.8:9: Greek ta echonta psychas ("those having life," lit., "those having souls/lives") stands in the nominative or accusative in apposition to the genitive "of the creatures," a characteristic grammatical irregularity in Revelation.
notes.8:11: Greek Apsinthos ("Wormwood") refers to an intensely bitter plant (Artemisia absinthium), associated in the Hebrew Scriptures with bitter sorrow and divine judgment (e.g., Jer 9:15; 23:15).
notes.8:13: The earliest and best manuscripts read "eagle" (aetou, which can also denote a vulture), whereas some later manuscripts substitute "angel" (angelou). Greek henos ("one") functions here as an indefinite article ("an eagle" or "a single eagle").
notes.9:11: Abaddon is a Hebrew name meaning "Destruction" (used in the Old Testament for the realm of the dead), and Apollyon is a Greek name meaning "Destroyer."
notes.9:13: The Greek text here reads simply "the horns" without the numeral "four" found in some later manuscripts.
notes.9:14: The Greek exhibits notable grammatical irregularities typical of Revelation, using a masculine participle ("saying") after the feminine noun "voice" and a nominative phrase ("the one holding the trumpet") in apposition to the dative "sixth angel."
notes.9:15: A single Greek definite article governs "hour and day and month and year," pointing to one exact, divinely appointed moment rather than a span of time.
notes.9:16: Literally "two myriads of myriads" (20,000 times 10,000, equaling 200,000,000).
notes.9:21: The Greek word pharmakon (plural) literally denotes drugs or magical potions and is used here for sorcery and occult practices.
notes.10:2: The Greek uses the diminutive biblaridion ("little scroll") here and in vv. 9-10, whereas v. 8 uses the standard noun biblion ("scroll"). The participle echon ("having/holding") stands in the nominative despite referring back to the accusative "angel" in v. 1, a grammatical irregularity characteristic of Revelation.
notes.10:6: Literally "time will no longer be" (chronos ouketi estai), an idiom meaning no further delay or period of waiting before the fulfillment described in v. 7.
notes.10:7: Literally "and the mystery of God was finished" (kai etelesthe), a Semitic construction combining an apodotic "and" ("then") with a prophetic aorist tense to express the certainty of future completion.
notes.10:8: The Greek shifts from the nominative "the voice" (he phone) to accusative participles ("speaking ... and saying"), an abrupt construction smoothed here into English; it also uses biblion ("scroll") rather than the diminutive biblaridion ("little scroll") found in vv. 2, 9, and 10.
notes.10:11: The plural "they said" (legousin) may refer jointly to the heavenly voice and the angel or function as an indefinite plural ("I was told"). The preposition epi with the dative can mean "concerning" or "against," and the final adjective "many" (pollois) may modify "kings" alone or the entire fourfold list.
notes.11:1: The Greek participle rendered "and someone said" (legon, lit. "saying") is masculine singular without an expressed subject; some later manuscripts add "and the angel stood" to supply one.
notes.11:3: Literally "I will give to My two witnesses, and they will prophesy," a Semitic paratactic idiom expressing the granting of a commission or authority to prophesy.
notes.11:8: The Greek uses the collective singular "corpse" (ptoma) here and in the first half of 11:9 before switching to the plural "corpses" (ptomata) in the second half of 11:9. "Spiritually" (pneumatikos) denotes a spiritual or symbolic sense.
notes.11:13: "Seven thousand people" renders the literal Greek "names of people, seven thousand" (onomata anthropon chiliades hepta), an idiom for counting individual persons.
notes.11:17: Unlike 1:4, 1:8, and 4:8, the critical Greek text omits "and who is to come" after "who is and who was," since God's reign has now arrived; the aorist ebasileusas ("begun to reign") is ingressive.
notes.12:5: The phrase "a son, a male" (υἱόν, ἄρρενα) reflects a Semitic idiom emphasizing the child's identity, while "shepherd" (ποιμαίνειν) directly echoes the Septuagint of Psalm 2:9.
notes.12:7: The Greek combines a nominative subject with a genitive articular infinitive (ὁ Μιχαὴλ καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι αὐτοῦ τοῦ πολεμῆσαι), a Semitic construction conveying that Michael and his angels fought against the dragon.
notes.12:11: The preposition διά with the accusative strictly expresses cause ("because of"), though many translations render it instrumentally ("by") in this context.
